facts.fact: Head of the Civil Service Didi Esther Walson-Jack said the federal Service-Wise GPT platform, an AI tool helping civil servants navigate service rules and institutional knowledge, has recorded over 50,000 conversations.

systems.owner: Office of the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation

NGA.note: The only AI tool named serves general administration, not a sector system.
No AI model, dataset or AI computing built or hosted in Nigeria is stated.
No digital-skills training for civil servants is stated.
The article thanks Galaxy Backbone and a partner for the 1Government Cloud programme but does not state who runs which systems for ministries.
